Dang, I like what that studio did with L4D, is Evolve as good, should I even bother?

Your mileage may very, but it's a pretty good game. It definitely has that same "team of four vs the world" kind of feeling that you get from Left 4 Dead, but being a vs game at heart it can suffer from some balancing issues. You'll have good games and bad games, so if you keep that in mind it's a pretty fun experience.
To me, the vs mode was the only way to play L4D. All the single / co-op stuff was just practice and warm-up.

You'll probably enjoy Evolve then. It's team vs team, with the co-op focus being on the monster hunters. It can have some balancing issues (I've been in matches where the monster does nothing but run and you never seen him) but they've been massaging those out with updates. It's tough to do a 1 vs 4 game well, but I think they did a good job with the idea.

Also, if you're looking for something with a L4D style, check out Payday 2. You play as four bank robbers pulling off various heists while defending against swarms of police and SWAT resistance. Although it's a little more objective based than L4D, it has a lot of similar themes like: highlighting teammates through walls, special enemy units with unique abilities, reviving your teammates while fighting off swarms of enemies, etc. The PC version is well supported, and it's recently released for the Xbox One and Playstation 4 with all previous DLC included. There are two caveats: an 8.5 GB download is required to play (if you buy the disc), and matchmaking is currently unreliable, though expected to be fixed eventually. Manually inviting and playing with friends is reliable.
